targets.approach: Walk northeast up the Weasel River valley from Thor Shelter along the hiking trail; the first climbs are at the southwest end of the wall. Birthday Crack is a short finger crack beside the neighboring easy line.
targets.name: Birthday Crack

targets.approach: Walk northeast up the Weasel River valley from Thor Shelter along the hiking trail; the first climbs are at the southwest end of the wall. This line is near the shelter and can be seen from the trail toward Summit Lake.
targets.name: No name Yet

targets.approach: Walk northeast up the Weasel River valley from Thor Shelter, toward the end of the cliff and stopping short of the last major waterfall, which falls between Mount Northumbria and the unnamed mountain to its northeast. The line starts on thin cracks and slabs that lead to layback corners next to the waterfall.
targets.descent_text: Descent is by the same rappel line used for the neighboring route Aalaapi, down to the base.
targets.name: Où sont passés les tuyaux ?
